text:
Maya-CS: Heads-up — EdenPay's pilot in APAC hit routing errors this morning. They reported 503s from edge in ap-southeast-1 and are asking for a scoped QPS bump + allowlist for their demo cluster. Renewal review in 48h, so we should avoid any visible flakiness.

Ravi-EdenPay: Sorry about the noise. We're on a tight window for a payments pilot demo for a potential merchant. Demo window: 2025-05-03 02:00-04:30 UTC (APAC-friendly). Can we open 900 QPS (sustained ~600) and allow outbound CIDR 203.0.113.0/25 for ap-southeast-1? Streaming chat + embeddings for receipts.

Maya-CS: They also asked whether we can route traffic to nearest edge region (ap-southeast-1) only — they want to avoid cross-region latency.

Tom-SRE: We can do a region-targeted allowlist + temporary QPS ceiling. Need exact org id and whether they want token-cost logging during window. Also confirm rolling warmup plan (recommended).

Ravi-EdenPay: Org: edenpay-pilot-prod. Yes please enable token-cost logs; we'll include cost in the demo. Warmup: 15m ramp starting at 01:45 UTC.

Sofia-Account: Renewal call set for 2025-05-05 10:00 UTC with procurement. If demo looks poor, they may push the contract decision.

Tom-SRE: Plan:
1) Apply allowlist 203.0.113.0/25 to outbound egress on ap-southeast-1 edge pool
2) Set per-org QPS ceiling to 1,000, per-route soft-limit to 900 for 2025-05-03T02:00:00Z - 2025-05-03T04:30:00Z
3) Restrict routing policy to prefer ap-southeast-1 for edenpay-pilot-prod during window
4) Enable token-level cost tracing and short retention of traces for audit
5) Auto-revoke rules + post-change verification 30 min after window end

Tom-SRE: Need ops ticket for audit. @ops-bot can you open TEMP-APAC-1765004321 with payload?

ops-bot: Creating ticket TEMP-APAC-1765004321 in queue customer-success.

Tom-SRE: Ticket payload to paste:
```
{
  "org": "edenpay-pilot-prod",
  "cidr": "203.0.113.0/25",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "start": "2025-05-03T02:00:00Z",
  "end": "2025-05-03T04:30:00Z",
  "qps_ceiling": "1000",
  "route_soft_limit": "900",
  "routing_policy": "prefer-ap-southeast-1",
  "token_cost_logging": "enabled",
  "reason": "Customer pilot demo; renewal at risk"
}
```

Maya-CS: Add contact to ticket: ravi+cs@edenpay.com and +65 8123 4567. Also flag as "high-touch" for Enablement to join the demo.

ops-bot: TEMP-APAC-1765004321 created. Assigned to tom-sre. SLA: 1h.

Tom-SRE: Implementing scoped change now (no service restart). Applying allowlist -> rule_id=r-ap1d9c3. Setting QPS and routing policy. Enabling token trace.

Luca-DevEx: I can join the demo for a quick intro to the dashboard and cost breakdown at start time. Please add me to the invite.

Tom-SRE: Confirmed: rule_id=r-ap1d9c3 applied, routing policy set to prefer ap-southeast-1, token traces live. Warmup ramp acknowledged.

Maya-CS: Ops reminder scheduled 20m before start. Luca, will add you to calendar. Ravi, please do the 15m warmup per plan.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled and will post 15m before window.

Tom-SRE: Post-demo note: change will auto-revoke at 2025-05-03T04:30:00Z, verification scheduled for 05:00Z. I'll post revoke logs and the aggregated token-cost CSV to TEMP-APAC-1765004321.

Tom-SRE: (after) Revoke complete. rule_id=r-ap1d9c3 removed at 2025-05-03T04:58:23Z. Verification passed: no lingering allowlist entries. Aggregated token delta attached to ticket.

Maya-CS: Customer reported demo success and liked the cost transparency. Procurement wants final quote; forwarding cost CSV to Sofia.

Sofia-Account: Got it. Adding cost delta to renewal packet. Marking this as a win for the pilot.

Maya-CS: Action items: 1) Add "ephemeral demo lift" step to onboarding checklist with warmup guidance 2) Create small Enablement playbook for customer-facing cost walkthroughs 3) SRE to add a short runbook for region-targeted temp rules.

Tom-SRE: I'll draft the runbook and include the ticket template.

Luca-DevEx: I'll create the Enablement notes and a one-pager showing where to find token-cost CSVs.

Maya-CS: Closing TEMP-APAC-1765004321 as resolved. Thanks team and @edenpay for the quick coordination :clap:
